profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Avo
profile.geoLocationName: Franklin Park, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
At the core of every innovative solution lies a blend of passion and purpose. I am driven by a commitment to excellence in software development, with a particular focus on automations and system integrations. My guiding principle is to leverage technology to create meaningful and impactful solutions that drive efficiency, enhance user experiences, and ultimately, make the world a little bit better. I believe in collaboration, continuous learning, and the relentless pursuit of innovation.

As an accomplished software engineer, my expertise spans across full-stack development, project management, and strategic planning. I have a proven track record in areas like technical support, vendor management, and creating robust automated systems. My proficiency includes working with diverse technologies such as Typescript, Python, Java, React, and GCP, which allow me to deliver end-to-end solutions that meet and exceed business objectives. My specialties include crafting predictive health analytics dashboards, directing technical teams, and automating complex workflows.

Throughout my career, I've been proud to achieve several notable milestones. One of my highlights includes leading a team at Cityblock Health to implement an automated ingestion pipeline on Google Cloud Platform, efficiently handling vast amounts of patient data daily. At Optum, I directed multiple teams to develop a groundbreaking insurance renewal application that won the 'Make IT Happen' award for innovation. Additionally, I played a key role in creating an AI model that helps diagnose patient issues based on symptoms, earning recognition in a company-wide Hackathon. My career is also enriched by my work at Goldman Sachs, where I managed asset tracking and system upgrades, ensuring seamless operations for a high-demand trading floor.

Looking ahead, I am eager to continue leveraging my extensive experience to drive technological advancements and operational improvements. My goal is to join forces with organizations dedicated to innovation and excellence, where I can contribute to building high-performing teams and developing solutions that deliver tangible results. Let's connect and explore how we can work together to achieve your strategic objectives and elevate your projects to new heights.
